prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. Approach, take and process the object if close, otherwise move or scan the area. list of available nodes: <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToObjecLocation    /> <Action ID = ProcessObject    /> <SubTree ID = ProcessObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
		DO ProcessObject
	END
